title: Rickover tells Townsend Brown the Navy is already on it

tellings.quote: hman rickover goes oh uh don't waste your time we're already on it like we know all about this

plain: Michels says that when the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who claimed electric charge could produce thrust like anti-gravity, brought his work to Admiral Hyman Rickover, the head of the Navy's nuclear program, Rickover told him not to waste his time because the Navy was already on it and knew all about it. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and if true it would mean the Navy was already working on such propulsion in secret.
